body.ruleText:
rule dac_win_0018 {
  meta:
    author = "DaC"
    description = "Security audit log cleared (1102) - Detects Event ID 1102 indicating the Security log was cleared, commonly used for defense evasion."
    severity = "High"
    rule_id = "DAC-WIN-0018"
    source_language = "spl"
    converted_by = "rulebridge"
    mitre_attack_technique = "T1685.005"

  events:
    $e.metadata.log_type = "WINEVTLOG"
    $e.metadata.product_event_type = "1102"
    $name = $e.principal.hostname

  match:
    $name over 1h

  outcome:
    $count = count($e.metadata.id)
    $users = array_distinct($e.principal.user.userid)

  condition:
    $e
}
